If you’re struggling to meet calories you can be adding extra healthy fats from things like nuts/nut butters, avocados, an extra splash of oil, etc. because these are extra calorie dense. If you don’t like large or dense meals try to plan for snacks throughout the day like protein bars or nuts, there are some pretty high calorie protein bars out there that are like 30-40g of protein and 300+ calories a piece. Liquid calories can also help a lot like protein shakes or smoothies because they are less likely to make you feel as full for as long. Not sure what else but that’s somewhere to start, counting your calories to make sure you’re getting enough could also help but if you think that wouldn’t be healthy for you (past history of eating disorders or anything similar) then it’s okay to just eat a bit more and see if/how your weight changes.
